=== BEGIN ARTIFACT TOPOLOGY.md ===
## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Python project root, environment, dependency manifest and pytest runner for the ledger.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   ARCHITECTURE.md
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     python-project
instructions: |
  Create the Python 3.11+ project tree at the application root: pyproject.toml, committed uv.lock,
  .venv via uv venv, pytest configured with tests/ and a conftest.py exposing the db_session and
  cli_runner fixtures. Document in ARCHITECTURE.md the module layout and ownership:
  `persistence` (generated, only owner of database drivers), `cli` (entry package: main,
  errors, commands/, testing), `ledgerlib` (domain: config, csvout, validation, rules).
  Money is integer cents everywhere; no float for money at any layer. Application code never
  reads sources/run.sh or seed files. Do not create the `ledger` executable or any command here.
acceptance:   yes
depends:

## story database
summary:      Declare and build the accounts, categories and transactions store through the shipped persistence library.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   DATABASE.md
stack:        persistence.md, sqlite.md, python.md
provides:     persistence
instructions: |
  Author-side declaration only; the persistence package is generated by Drydock and no persistence
  code is written by hand. Tables: accounts(account TEXT PK, name TEXT NOT NULL),
  categories(category TEXT PK, description TEXT NOT NULL),
  transactions(txn_id INTEGER PK, date TEXT NOT NULL, account TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts,
  category TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES categories, amount INTEGER NOT NULL, memo TEXT NOT NULL),
  with an index on transactions(account) and transactions(date).
  Declare access patterns for every operation any story needs: accounts create/get/list/update(name)/
  delete/clear; categories create/get/list/clear; transactions create (explicit txn_id)/get/
  list (optional account filter, ordered by txn_id asc)/update(amount)/delete/clear. A `clear`
  operation is a many-row delete using a comparison Match term (for example `txn_id >= min_txn_id`)
  so it needs no new Kind. Ledger reports are computed in Python from list operations, never from
  stored aggregates.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      foundation

## story cli-entry
summary:      Provide the `ledger` executable, the cli package dispatcher, and exit-code error mapping.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliEntry.md
stack:        cli.md, python.md
provides:     ledger, cli.main
consumes:     python-project, persistence
instructions: |
  Create `ledger` at the application root: an executable POSIX sh launcher that uses .venv/bin/python
  when present (else python3) to call cli.main(sys.argv[1:]) and exit with its return value.
  cli/__init__.py defines main(argv) -> int and cli/testing.py defines cli_runner per the CLI
  foundation contract. cli/errors.py defines CliError with exit_code and subclasses
  OperationalError (1), UsageError (2), RejectedError (3), NotFoundError (4).
  Dispatch: argv[0] names a module `cli.commands.<command>` imported lazily; each module exposes
  `run(args: list[str]) -> list[str]` returning output lines (no printing). main buffers output and
  writes it to stdout only when run succeeds; on CliError it writes one diagnostic line to stderr,
  nothing to stdout, and returns the error's exit_code; any other exception is exit 1. A missing
  command module is a UsageError. No command logic lives here.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      foundation, database

## story test-runner
summary:      Provide the POSIX bin/test.sh application test runner.
type:         service
kind:         test harness
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-TestRunner.md
covers:       CLI-004
stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     bin/test.sh
consumes:     python-project
instructions: |
  Create bin/test.sh, POSIX sh, which changes to the application root, activates .venv when present,
  runs `pytest -q`, and exits zero only when every test passes. No test may itself invoke bin/test.sh.
  Add at least one meaningful project test so the runner has something to run.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      foundation

## story setup-config
summary:      Resolve the ledger database location from DATABASE_URL, DATABASE_PATH or data/app.db and refuse PostgreSQL.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-DatabaseSelection.md
covers:       SETUP-001
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledgerlib.config
consumes:     cli.main, persistence
instructions: |
  ledgerlib/config.py resolves the DSN: DATABASE_URL, else DATABASE_PATH, else data/app.db; a leading
  `sqlite://` is stripped. A value beginning postgres:// or postgresql:// raises OperationalError
  (exit 1) before any file is created or written. ledgerlib exposes open_ledger() returning an open
  persistence Database for the resolved location; an unreachable database or a file that is not a
  valid database raises OperationalError with nothing on stdout.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      cli-entry

## story csv-output
summary:      Format integer cents and CSV rows exactly as the output contract requires.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-CsvOutput.md
covers:       CLI-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledgerlib.csvout
consumes:     cli.main
instructions: |
  ledgerlib/csvout.py: format_cents(int) -> str with exactly two decimals, leading `-` when negative,
  no thousands separator, using integer arithmetic only so zero is `0.00` and never `-0.00`.
  Row helpers join fields with commas, no quoting, no trailing spaces, and the command returns
  lines that main joins with `\n` endings. Provide helpers for the account row, transaction row,
  and header constants shared by every command.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      cli-entry

## story validation
summary:      Validate codes, names, memos, amounts and dates per the ledger rules.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Validation.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledgerlib.validation
consumes:     cli.main
instructions: |
  ledgerlib/validation.py raises RejectedError (exit 3) on violation. Codes: 1-12 chars of A-Z0-9.
  Names and descriptions: 1-40 chars; memos 0-60 chars; none contain comma or newline.
  Amounts match -?DIGITS[.D[D]], at most two decimals, never zero; parse to integer cents with
  integer arithmetic (no float). Dates are real calendar dates YYYY-MM-DD (2026-02-30 rejected).
  Transaction id arguments must be strings of decimal digits, else RejectedError.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      cli-entry

## story ledger-rules
summary:      Compute account balances and views, enforce the non-negative balance rule, and allocate transaction ids.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LedgerRules.md
stack:        python.md, cli.md
context:      DATABASE.md
provides:     ledgerlib.rules
consumes:     persistence, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  ledgerlib/rules.py, all through db.<table>.<operation>: account_view(db, code) giving
  transaction count and balance in cents; balances_after(db, changes) projecting each affected
  account's final balance after a whole set of changes; require_non_negative(...) raising
  RejectedError when any projected balance is below zero; next_txn_id(db) giving the largest
  txn_id plus one, or 1 when empty. Callers read the id and write the row in one database
  transaction so concurrent posts never share an id. Every check happens before the first write.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      database, csv-output, validation

## story setup-init
summary:      Implement `ledger init` to prepare an empty ledger and clear existing rows.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Init.md
covers:       SETUP-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger init
consumes:     ledgerlib.config, persistence
instructions: |
  cli/commands/init.py: creates the parent directory of the SQLite file when missing, opens the
  database through open_database (which provisions the declared tables idempotently), then clears
  every row of transactions, then categories, then accounts using the declared clear operations.
  Writes nothing to stdout; exit 0. Rerunning removes all rows. No driver import and no DDL
  outside the persistence library.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      setup-config

## story setup-count
summary:      Implement `ledger count` printing row counts per table.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-Count.md
covers:       SETUP-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger count
consumes:     ledgerlib.config, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  cli/commands/count.py prints `table,rows` then accounts, categories, transactions in that order,
  with each count taken from list operations at run time. Wrong argument count is a UsageError.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      setup-config, csv-output

## story load-accounts
summary:      Implement `ledger load accounts <csv>` as an all-or-nothing load.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md
covers:       LOAD-001
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger load accounts
consumes:     ledgerlib.config, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  Create cli/commands/load.py with a per-table handler registry (unknown table is UsageError);
  this story adds the accounts handler. Header must be exactly `account,name`; every row has the
  header's field count; codes and names are validated; duplicate codes within the file or against
  stored accounts are rejected. Any problem is RejectedError (exit 3) before the first write and
  stores nothing; an unreadable file is OperationalError (exit 1). A header-only file loads zero
  rows and prints `accounts,0`. Output: `table,loaded` then `accounts,<rows>`. Writes happen in one
  database transaction. Seed file sources/seed_accounts.csv may be used in acceptance only.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      setup-config, validation, csv-output

## story load-categories
summary:      Implement `ledger load categories <csv>` as an all-or-nothing load.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadCategories.md
covers:       LOAD-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger load categories
consumes:     ledger load accounts, ledgerlib.validation
instructions: |
  Add the categories handler to cli/commands/load.py. Header must be exactly `category,description`;
  same atomicity, duplicate, field-count and validation rules as accounts. Output `table,loaded`
  then `categories,<rows>`.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      load-accounts

## story load-transactions
summary:      Implement `ledger load transactions <csv>` with whole-file balance checking.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        2
implements:   FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md
covers:       LOAD-003
accepts:      st-004, st-007
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger load transactions
consumes:     ledger load categories, ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation
instructions: |
  Add the transactions handler to cli/commands/load.py. Header exactly
  `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`; each row keeps its file txn_id. Reject with exit 3
  and store nothing for: unknown account or category, duplicate txn_id (in file or already stored),
  invalid date, amount or memo, wrong field count, and any account whose balance after the whole
  file is applied would be negative (evaluated on final balances, not row by row). Output
  `table,loaded` then `transactions,<rows>`. Acceptance loads accounts and categories first.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      load-categories, ledger-rules

## story acct-add
summary:      Implement `ledger account add <code> <name>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-AccountAdd.md
covers:       ACCT-001
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account add
consumes:     ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  Create cli/commands/account.py with a verb table (unknown verb or wrong argument count is
  UsageError). add validates code and name, rejects a duplicate code with exit 3, and prints
  `account,name,transactions,balance` plus the new row with 0 transactions and balance 0.00.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      ledger-rules, load-categories

## story acct-get
summary:      Implement `ledger account get <code>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-AccountGet.md
covers:       ACCT-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account get
consumes:     ledger account add, ledgerlib.rules
instructions: |
  Add the get verb: prints the account row with its current transaction count and balance computed
  from stored transactions; an absent code is NotFoundError (exit 4).
acceptance:   yes
depends:      acct-add

## story acct-rename
summary:      Implement `ledger account rename <code> <name>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-AccountRename.md
covers:       ACCT-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account rename
consumes:     ledger account get, ledgerlib.validation
instructions: |
  Add the rename verb: validate the name (exit 3 when invalid), absent code exits 4, otherwise
  update and print the updated account row read back from storage.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      acct-get

## story acct-delete
summary:      Implement `ledger account delete <code>` with in-use refusal.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-AccountDelete.md
covers:       ACCT-004
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger account delete
consumes:     ledger account rename, ledger load transactions
instructions: |
  Add the delete verb: absent code exits 4; an account with any transactions is refused with exit 3
  and nothing changes; otherwise delete and print `deleted` then the code.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      acct-rename, load-transactions

## story txn-post
summary:      Implement `ledger txn post` with id allocation and balance check.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-TxnPost.md
covers:       TXN-001
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn post
consumes:     ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  Create cli/commands/txn.py with a verb table. post takes <account> <category> <amount> <date>
  [<memo>] (memo defaults to empty). Validate every input, require the account and category exist
  (exit 3), check the projected balance is not negative (exit 3), then allocate the id and write the
  row in one database transaction. Print `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and the row.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      ledger-rules, load-categories, acct-add

## story txn-get
summary:      Implement `ledger txn get <id>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-TxnGet.md
covers:       TXN-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn get
consumes:     ledger txn post
instructions: |
  Add the get verb: a non-digit id is RejectedError (exit 3); an absent id is NotFoundError (exit 4);
  otherwise print the transaction row.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      txn-post

## story txn-amend
summary:      Implement `ledger txn amend <id> <amount>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-TxnAmend.md
covers:       TXN-003
accepts:      st-006
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn amend
consumes:     ledger txn get
instructions: |
  Add the amend verb: validate id and amount, absent id exits 4, reject with exit 3 when the new
  amount would leave the account balance below zero, otherwise change only the amount and print the
  updated row read back from storage.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      txn-get

## story txn-delete
summary:      Implement `ledger txn delete <id>`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-TxnDelete.md
covers:       TXN-004
accepts:      st-008
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger txn delete
consumes:     ledger txn get
instructions: |
  Add the delete verb: absent id exits 4; a deletion that would leave the account balance below
  zero exits 3 and changes nothing; otherwise delete and print `deleted` then the id. Deleting one
  leg of a transfer is allowed under the same rule and leaves the other leg unchanged.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      txn-get

## story transfer
summary:      Implement `ledger transfer` writing two TRANSFER rows atomically.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        3
implements:   FEATURE-Transfer.md
covers:       XFER-001
accepts:      st-010, st-007
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger transfer
consumes:     ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  cli/commands/transfer.py: `transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`. Amount must be positive, the
  accounts must differ and exist, category TRANSFER must exist, and the source balance must stay
  non-negative; all checked before writing (exit 3). Allocate consecutive ids and write both rows
  in one database transaction: `-amount` on <from> with memo `transfer to <to>` then `+amount` on
  <to> with memo `transfer from <from>`. Print the transaction header and both rows.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      ledger-rules, validation, load-categories

## story rpt-balances
summary:      Implement `ledger report balances`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-ReportBalances.md
covers:       RPT-001
accepts:      st-005
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger report balances
consumes:     ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.csvout
instructions: |
  Create cli/commands/report.py with a report-name table (unknown report is UsageError).
  balances prints `account,name,transactions,balance` per account ordered by code, then
  `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where count is the total number of transactions and sum is the total
  balance. All values are computed from stored rows at run time. An empty ledger prints the header
  and `TOTAL,,0,0.00`.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      ledger-rules, load-transactions

## story rpt-categories
summary:      Implement `ledger report categories`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-ReportCategories.md
covers:       RPT-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger report categories
consumes:     ledger report balances
instructions: |
  Add categories: `category,description,transactions,inflow,outflow,net` per category ordered by
  code, including categories with no transactions, then `TOTAL,,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`.
  inflow sums positive amounts, outflow sums absolute values of negative amounts, net = inflow -
  outflow, all in integer cents.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      rpt-balances

## story rpt-monthly
summary:      Implement `ledger report monthly`.
type:         service
kind:         capability
phase:        4
implements:   FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md
covers:       RPT-003
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     ledger report monthly
consumes:     ledger report balances
instructions: |
  Add monthly: `month,transactions,inflow,outflow,net` per YYYY-MM that has transactions, ascending,
  then `TOTAL,<count>,<inflow>,<outflow>,<net>`. An empty ledger prints the header and
  `TOTAL,0,0.00,0.00,0.00`.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      rpt-balances

## story cli-usage
summary:      Guarantee usage errors exit 2 with a one-line usage on standard error for every command.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-UsageErrors.md
covers:       CLI-001
accepts:      st-011
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     cli.usage
consumes:     ledger, ledger init, ledger count, ledger load accounts, ledger load categories, ledger load transactions, ledger account add, ledger account get, ledger account rename, ledger account delete, ledger txn post, ledger txn get, ledger txn amend, ledger txn delete, ledger transfer, ledger report balances, ledger report categories, ledger report monthly
instructions: |
  Make `ledger` with no arguments, an unknown command, unknown table, unknown report, unknown verb
  or wrong argument count exit 2 with nothing on stdout and a one-line usage text for the offending
  command or sub-verb on stderr. Provide a single usage table covering every command and verb in
  the command table. Argument-count checks happen before any database access.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      setup-init, setup-count, load-transactions, acct-delete, txn-amend, txn-delete, transfer, rpt-categories, rpt-monthly

## story cli-operational
summary:      Guarantee operational failures exit 1 with nothing on standard output.
type:         service
kind:         integration
phase:        5
implements:   FEATURE-OperationalFailures.md
covers:       CLI-002
stack:        python.md, cli.md
provides:     cli.operational
consumes:     ledgerlib.config, ledger count, ledger load accounts, ledger report balances
instructions: |
  Ensure an unreachable database, a file that is not a valid database, missing tables, a PostgreSQL
  DSN and an unreadable load file each exit 1 with empty stdout and one stderr line, for every
  command that touches the database, and that no write occurred.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      setup-init, setup-count, load-transactions, acct-delete, txn-amend, txn-delete, transfer, rpt-categories, rpt-monthly

## story verify
summary:      Run the supplied end-to-end grader unfiltered as the terminal gate.
type:         feature
kind:         integration
phase:        6
implements:   VERIFICATION.md
covers:       VERIFY-001
accepts:      st-001
stack:        common.md
consumes:     ledger, test-runner-contract
instructions: |
  Assembly and intent only: confirm every command story is complete and run `sh sources/run.sh`
  from the application root, requiring exit 0. Also run `sh bin/test.sh` and require exit 0.
  Declare Suite: full on the grader criterion. Do not read run.sh from application code.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      cli-usage, cli-operational, test-runner

## Declarations

## story foundation
summary:      Stand up the Python project root, environment, dependency manifest and pytest runner for the ledger.
type:         foundational

stack:        common.md, python.md
provides:     python-project
instructions: |
  Create the Python 3.11+ project tree at the application root: pyproject.toml, committed uv.lock,

## story cli-entry
summary:      Provide the `ledger` executable, the cli package dispatcher, and exit-code error mapping.
type:         foundational
kind:         capability
phase:        1
implements:   FEATURE-CliEntry.md
stack:        cli.md, python.md
provides:     ledger, cli.main
consumes:     python-project, persistence
instructions: |
  Create `ledger` at the application root: an executable POSIX sh launcher that uses .venv/bin/python
  when present (else python3) to call cli.main(sys.argv[1:]) and exit with its return value.
  cli/__init__.py defines main(argv) -> int and cli/testing.py defines cli_runner per the CLI
  foundation contract. cli/errors.py defines CliError with exit_code and subclasses
  OperationalError (1), UsageError (2), RejectedError (3), NotFoundError (4).
  Dispatch: argv[0] names a module `cli.commands.<command>` imported lazily; each module exposes
  `run(args: list[str]) -> list[str]` returning output lines (no printing). main buffers output and
  writes it to stdout only when run succeeds; on CliError it writes one diagnostic line to stderr,
  nothing to stdout, and returns the error's exit_code; any other exception is exit 1. A missing
  command module is a UsageError. No command logic lives here.
acceptance:   yes
depends:      foundation, database
